content:
**OPNduck v0.2.0-Alpha** 🦆

Out of Pre-Alpha - the Downloader now does real, end-to-end media downloading instead of being a UI stub.

**Highlights**
• Real media downloading via `yt-dlp` (system PATH), driving a new `Host.tasks` seam
• Full download queue: multiple concurrent downloads, per-item cancel, live progress
• Video quality (Best/2160p/1080p/720p/480p/360p) and MP3 bitrate (Best/320k/192k/128k) selection, with an approximate file-size preview before you hit download
• Thumbnails on the Downloader card and Downloads queue
• A default-download-folder setting with a real native folder picker
• A plain-language install banner when `yt-dlp` isn't on PATH yet
• A pile of UI fixes: Monochrome theme glow leak, Settings scroll-spy, page-slide animation, top-bar overflow, hamburger-menu clipping, window minimum-size on Wayland, and scrollbars removed app-wide

Verified clean via `tsc -b`, `vite build`, and `oxlint`.

Convert/AI engines are still stubbed - they land in later Alpha updates. Expect bugs.
